R1871.summary: A postscript Foscarini added after signing his despatch: reports of Spanish reinforcements in the Milanese, and Louis XIV's reported plan to raise the Pinerolo garrison to 6,000 men and spread 16,000 over Dauphiné and Provence, with the Duke of Mantua's illness and a feared Spanish move on Casale; munitions reaching Pinerolo by way of Savoy. Read by Paolo Bonavoglia (crittologia.eu).
R1871.en:
Most Serene Prince,

After the despatch was signed, a report was sent to me. Although I cannot give it full faith, having no time to look
for confirmation, the weight it carries means I must not fail to pass it on to Your Serenity.

On the reports that keep coming from Italy that the Spaniards are considerably increasing their troops in the
Milanese, I am told that the King, who has a great number of soldiers under arms, has resolved to reinforce the
garrison of Pinerolo up to six thousand men of the old regiments, and to distribute sixteen thousand fighting men in
Dauphiné and Provence, so as to be ready, should the occasion arise, stronger than the Spaniards themselves.

It is not unlikely that the news written to me by a confidant of mine at court is true.

system: Foscarini's 1680s numerical nomenclator (used at Paris and Madrid per Bonavoglia). Segmented here as 3-digit groups (first digit 1-5, second 1-6, third 0-9; rare digits 0/7/8/9 only in third place), 211 distinct of a table of about 300 codes (110-569); not…
